source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ethical use of information (PDF 188).

blocks.text: Maloomat ka ethical (akhlaqi) istemal ka matlab hai data aur content ko fair (munsifana) aur lawful (qanoon ke mutabiq) tareeqe se sambhalna. Agle do hisse is ke do pehlu batate hain: zimmedari se data share karna, aur copyright aur plagiarism ke masail.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 9: Maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kya shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: (b) Copyright ka ehtaram aur plagiarism se bachna.

items: Ethical use: data aur content ko insaf aur qanoon ke mutabiq sambhalna.
